name: Dimitry Snezhkov
biography: Dimitry Snezhkov is a Sr. Security Consultant for X-Force Red. In this role he hacks code, tools, networks, apps and sometimes subverts human behavior too. Dimitry has spoken at DEF CON, THOTCON, DerbyCon, CircleCityCon, NorthSec, and presented tools at BlackHat Arsenal. Twitter: @Op_Nomad
